evals.name: due-date-holiday
evals.prompt: I need to estimate when a backend task will be done. It starts on April 9, 2026, and the estimate is 24 hours of work. When is the due date? (We follow Bangladesh work week and official public holidays.)
evals.expected_output: Due date of 2026-04-15, accounting for the Pahela Baishakh holiday on April 14

assertions.name: correct_due_date
assertions.text: The answer states the due date is 2026-04-15 (April 15, 2026)

assertions.name: mentions_pahela_baishakh
assertions.text: The answer mentions Pahela Baishakh (or Bengali New Year / Bangla New Year) as a holiday on April 14 that affects the schedule

assertions.name: uses_script
assertions.text: The answer shows output from the dates.py script (JSON with start/due/workingDays fields)

assertions.name: cache_check_performed
assertions.text: The agent checked holiday cache status before running the calculation (ran cache-status command or checked for .holiday-cache/2026.json)

evals.name: sequential-schedule
evals.prompt: Schedule three tasks for a single developer starting April 13, 2026 in Bangladesh. Task 1: Set up Redis — 16 hours. Task 2: Configure load balancer — 8 hours. Task 3: Deploy monitoring stack — 24 hours. Give me a start and due date for each.
evals.expected_output: Task 1: Apr 13 → Apr 16 (skips Apr 14 holiday), Task 2: Apr 16 → Apr 19, Task 3: Apr 19 → Apr 22

assertions.name: task1_due_apr16
assertions.text: Task 1 (Redis / 16h) has a due date of 2026-04-16 (April 16)

assertions.name: task2_due_apr19
assertions.text: Task 2 (load balancer / 8h) has a due date of 2026-04-19 (April 19)

assertions.name: task3_due_apr22
assertions.text: Task 3 (monitoring / 24h) has a due date of 2026-04-22 (April 22)

assertions.name: holiday_skipped
assertions.text: The answer explains that April 14 (Pahela Baishakh) is a public holiday and affects Task 1's schedule

evals.name: count-remaining-april
evals.prompt: How many working days are left in April 2026, starting from today (April 8, 2026)? We work Sunday through Thursday in Bangladesh.
evals.expected_output: 16 working days remaining (Apr 8–30), deducting Pahela Baishakh on Apr 14

assertions.name: mentions_holiday_deduction
assertions.text: The answer mentions that April 14 (Pahela Baishakh / Bengali New Year) is a public holiday excluded from the count

assertions.name: correct_date_range
assertions.text: The calculation covers April 8 through April 30, 2026
